main.title: Before you come
main.lead: If yours isn’t here, email hello@example.com.

items.title: Will talks be recorded?
items.text: Yes, every talk, online two weeks after the event.

items.title: Can I get a refund?
items.text: Until 1 February, minus a €20 fee; after that, transfer your ticket instead.

items.title: Is there food for every diet?
items.text: Yes; tell us yours when you name the attendee.
